title: 🧪 The Science Camp Mystery
intro: Panda, Rabbit, Elephant, and Otter signed up for every station at Science Camp -- but the sign-up sheet got rained on and all the names smudged away! Can you figure out which camper is at which station?
clues: Panda's station is not Plant Growth or Stargazing.
Rabbit's station is not Plant Growth.
hints: Clue 1 hands you Elephant's answer outright: Volcano. Mark it and cross Elephant off everywhere else.
Now that Volcano is taken, clue 2 rules out two more stations for Panda at once -- only one station is left for Panda. Which one?
Magnets and Volcano are gone, so only Plant Growth and Stargazing are left for Otter and Rabbit. Clue 3 says Otter isn't Stargazing -- so what must Otter be?
Whatever's left over for Rabbit once Otter is filled in is Rabbit's answer -- clue 4 just double-checks it for you.
